verdict:
KILL - and per doctrine this is a DATA/INTEGRITY kill, not a valuation gate. That distinction is the whole ruling: an unclosed first-order integrity gap kills, it does not gate, so no price trigger may seat this position. No escalation trigger fires: benches concordant, no ADVANCE, not held, next print ~50 trading days out.

THE CHEAPNESS IS REAL. Nobody in the record disputes it. Treating the converts as converted, EV is about $3.05B - roughly 6.1x FY26 adjusted EBIT, 4.9x adjusted EBITDA, 8.6x FCF and 10.0x adjusted EPS, with $1,034.1M of cash and investments against $418.0M of converts. On GAAP it is about 12.1x ($450.8M operating income, $338.2M net income against a $4.08B fully-diluted cap). Even a bear run-rate that carries General Education at -9.7% and Career at +8% only takes FY27 revenue to ~$2.46B and EV/EBIT to ~7x. The price is not paying for growth; it is paying for a tail.

AND EVERY BOUND ON THAT TAIL FAILED. The thesis needed the integrity allegation to be bounded, and it offered four bounds. (1) 'The FY27 revenue guide issued with the print' - there IS no FY27 guidance in the release, for revenue, adjusted operating income or capex. A five-day-old CEO withholding the guide into the very enrollment window the thesis calls decisive is a tell, not an omission. (2) 'No restatement retires the fraud tail's worst branch' - the company disclosed material weakness in its FY23 and FY24 10-Ks, three 10-Qs and an 8-K, and blue read the 8-K verbatim: BDO's 2023-08-15 report expressed an ADVERSE ICFR opinion on IT general controls covering user access, program change and data processing. That is squarely resonant with an enrollment-platform integrity allegation, and the class period opens 2024-10-22 right as the material-weakness era closes. Red hedged that the FY26 10-K was 'absent from MW hits (weakly clean)'; blue REFUTED it - the FY26 10-K IS a material-weakness full-text hit, with the location unresolvable because the 2.94MB document truncates. (3) Item 3 Legal Proceedings and Item 9A Controls remain UNREAD after THREE independent fetch routes across three documents - direct sec.gov 403s, the proxy truncates around page 22, and the table of contents places Item 3 at page 41 and Item 9A at page 100. So KPMG's ICFR opinion and any litigation accrual are simply unknown. (4) No insider bought. All four Form 4s are now decoded - the new CEO Knowling, the CFO Blackman, the GC and an MD - and every one is A-codes and F-codes only, grants and tax withholding, with the new CEO's incentive struck as price-CAGR RSRs to 2029. Zero open-market P purchases, including by the man hired to fix it.

BLUE'S CORRECTION IN THE NAME'S FAVOUR, RECORDED PROPERLY: the originating fraud complaint came from Gallup-McKinley County Schools - a paying district PARTNER, not shareholders - alleging ghost-student enrollment inflation to secure state funding. Red flagged the revenue-channel exposure the securities suit does not carry. Blue then found the timeline red missed: GMCS TERMINATED the contract effective 2025-06-30, announced 2025-05-28, before the September complaint and before FY26 began. So that revenue is already realised inside the FY26 comps and is NOT a pending forward tail. What remains is arbitration damages, New Mexico clawback exposure, and replication risk in other states - real, but smaller than red priced it. Note the venue is New Mexico state court, where CourtListener is structurally blind, so the desk cannot track it with existing connectors.

THE STRUCTURAL POINT WORTH KEEPING REGARDLESS OF THE VERDICT: LRN's decisive variable - fall enrollment - is SET during August and September and DISCLOSED in late October. There is a roughly ten-week window in which the number exists and the market cannot see it. That is precisely the asymmetry a desk with alternative data should own. Except it doesn't: hiring_velocity was dispatched and returned NO observations for want of keywords and location parameters, so the claimed edge is currently prose, not a running mechanism. Both benches said so. Instrument it now, in August, or the window closes unexploited for the second consecutive year.

court.record: batch4 8/15; red 7/blue 8 SUSTAINED with two corrections, one in each direction - outcome CONCORDANT. Blue REFUTED red's 'FY26 10-K weakly clean on material weakness' (it IS a full-text hit) and decoded the two Form 4s red could not, while correcting the customer-litigation timeline in the name's favour.

Three fetch routes have failed; a chunked-read approach (the same R-file/section-offset technique that closed HTT's 20-F gap) is the fix. Doctrine: a first-order integrity gap kills, it does not gate - a cheap multiple must NOT auto-seat this.
